title: financial recessions
meaning_vi: các cuộc suy thoái kinh tế

examples.en: Tourism revenues tend to fall sharply during financial recessions, leaving many workers unemployed.

title: tourism
meaning_vi: ngành du lịch

examples.en: Tourism remains one of the most reliable sources of foreign currency for many developing nations.

title: the rate of return
meaning_vi: tỷ suất lợi nhuận

examples.en: Investors in eco-lodges often accept a lower rate of return in exchange for minimising environmental damage.

title: globalization
meaning_vi: toàn cầu hóa

examples.en: Globalization has made it possible for budget airlines to fly tourists to once-inaccessible destinations.

title: tradeoff
meaning_vi: sự đánh đổi

examples.en: There is an inevitable tradeoff between economic growth and preserving a destination's natural beauty.

title: enter a new market
meaning_vi: thâm nhập thị trường mới

examples.en: International hotel chains often enter a new market by buying up land near popular heritage sites.

title: developing countries
meaning_vi: các nước đang phát triển

examples.en: Many developing countries depend heavily on tourism to fund public infrastructure.

title: tourism industries
meaning_vi: ngành công nghiệp du lịch

examples.en: Governments are investing heavily to modernise their tourism industries after years of decline.

title: production technology
meaning_vi: công nghệ sản xuất

examples.en: Advances in production technology have made it possible for airlines to build aircraft at a fraction of the previous cost.

title: average cost of producing each unit
term: average cost of producing each unit
meaning_vi: chi phí trung bình để sản xuất mỗi đơn vị

examples.en: As factories scale up, the average cost of producing each unit falls, allowing airlines to sell cheaper tickets.

title: closely associated with the growth of the economy
term: closely associated with the growth of the economy
pronunciation: /ˈkləʊsli əˈsəʊʃieɪtɪd wɪð ðə ɡrəʊθ əv ði ɪˈkɒnəmi/
meaning_vi: gắn liền chặt chẽ với sự tăng trưởng kinh tế

examples.en: The expansion of the airline sector is closely associated with the growth of the economy in developing nations.

title: tourist-related services
meaning_vi: các dịch vụ liên quan đến du lịch

examples.en: A large proportion of the town's workforce is now employed in tourist-related services such as guiding and catering.

title: provide modest incomes
meaning_vi: mang lại thu nhập khiêm tốn

examples.en: Small guesthouses often provide modest incomes for families living in rural tourist areas.

title: create new economic opportunities
meaning_vi: tạo ra các cơ hội kinh tế mới

examples.en: Tourism can create new economic opportunities for communities that previously relied solely on farming.

title: has seen considerable improvements in local living standards
term: has seen considerable improvements in local living standards
pronunciation: /hæz siːn kənˈsɪdərəbl ɪmˈpruːvmənts ɪn ˈləʊkəl ˈlɪvɪŋ ˈstændədz/
meaning_vi: đã chứng kiến sự cải thiện đáng kể trong mức sống của người dân địa phương

examples.en: The region has seen considerable improvements in local living standards since tourism became its main industry.

title: move away from subsistence living
meaning_vi: thoát khỏi lối sống tự cung tự cấp

examples.en: Tourism has allowed many villagers to move away from subsistence living and pursue more stable careers.

title: embrace more diversified sources of income
term: embrace more diversified sources of income
meaning_vi: chuyển sang các nguồn thu nhập đa dạng hơn

examples.en: Local families are increasingly encouraged to embrace more diversified sources of income beyond agriculture.

title: exorbitant costs
meaning_vi: chi phí đắt đỏ quá mức

examples.en: The exorbitant costs of space travel mean that this form of tourism remains accessible only to the ultra-rich.

title: boost the economy of the aerospace industry
term: boost the economy of the aerospace industry
pronunciation: /buːst ði ɪˈkɒnəmi əv ði ˈeərəʊspeɪs ˈɪndəstri/
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy nền kinh tế của ngành hàng không vũ trụ

examples.en: Space tourism is expected to boost the economy of the aerospace industry in the coming decades.

title: generated jobs and investment in the private space sector
term: generated jobs and investment in the private space sector
pronunciation: /ˈdʒenəreɪtɪd dʒɒbz ənd ɪnˈvestmənt ɪn ðə ˈpraɪvət speɪs ˈsektə/
meaning_vi: tạo ra việc làm và thu hút đầu tư vào ngành không gian tư nhân

examples.en: Space tourism has already generated jobs and investment in the private space sector worldwide.

title: encourage the exploration of new resources and discoveries
term: encourage the exploration of new resources and discoveries
pronunciation: /ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒ ði ˌeksplɔːˈreɪʃən əv njuː rɪˈsɔːsɪz ənd dɪˈskʌvəriz/
meaning_vi: khuyến khích việc khám phá các nguồn tài nguyên và phát hiện mới

examples.en: Investment in space tourism can encourage the exploration of new resources and discoveries beyond Earth.

title: help advance scientific knowledge about the origin of life
term: help advance scientific knowledge about the origin of life
pronunciation: /help ədˈvɑːns ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk ˈnɒlɪdʒ əˈbaʊt ði ˈɒrɪdʒɪn əv laɪf/
meaning_vi: giúp nâng cao hiểu biết khoa học về nguồn gốc sự sống

examples.en: Space missions funded partly by tourism revenue can help advance scientific knowledge about the origin of life.

title: boosting the aerospace industry
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy ngành công nghiệp hàng không vũ trụ

examples.en: Beyond boosting the aerospace industry, space tourism also inspires young people to pursue science careers.

title: facilitating important discoveries
meaning_vi: tạo điều kiện cho những khám phá quan trọng

examples.en: Private space flights are gradually facilitating important discoveries that benefit scientific research.

title: brings in significant revenue
meaning_vi: mang lại nguồn thu đáng kể

examples.en: The annual food festival brings in significant revenue for small restaurants across the city.

title: aid economic development
meaning_vi: hỗ trợ phát triển kinh tế

examples.en: Well-managed tourism can aid economic development in remote regions with few other industries.

title: decrease the dependency upon human labor
term: decrease the dependency upon human labor
meaning_vi: giảm sự phụ thuộc vào lao động con người

examples.en: Automated check-in kiosks at airports decrease the dependency upon human labor and speed up processing times.

title: offer flights to more far-fetched locations
term: offer flights to more far-fetched locations
meaning_vi: cung cấp các chuyến bay đến những địa điểm xa xôi hơn

examples.en: Budget carriers now offer flights to more far-fetched locations that were once accessible only to wealthy travellers.

title: create more employment
meaning_vi: tạo thêm việc làm

examples.en: New resorts along the coast create more employment for residents in nearby fishing villages.

title: provides a stable income for local dwellers
term: provides a stable income for local dwellers
pronunciation: /prəˈvaɪdz ə ˈsteɪbl ˈɪnkʌm fɔː ˈləʊkəl ˈdweləz/
meaning_vi: mang lại thu nhập ổn định cho cư dân địa phương

examples.en: The seasonal ski industry provides a stable income for local dwellers throughout the winter months.

title: raise the living standards
meaning_vi: nâng cao mức sống

examples.en: Tourism revenue has helped raise the living standards of many families in the region.

title: local identity
meaning_vi: bản sắc địa phương

examples.en: Preserving local identity should be a priority when destinations are developed for mass tourism.

title: international travel
meaning_vi: du lịch quốc tế

examples.en: International travel has made it easier than ever for people to experience unfamiliar cultures.

title: global brand
meaning_vi: thương hiệu toàn cầu

examples.en: The spread of global brands in historic city centres has made many destinations look strikingly similar.

title: architectural style
meaning_vi: phong cách kiến trúc

examples.en: Traditional architectural style is often lost when cities rebuild to accommodate mass tourism.

title: cultural blending
meaning_vi: sự pha trộn văn hóa

examples.en: Cultural blending brought about by tourism can enrich communities, but it may also dilute local traditions.

title: cultural richness
meaning_vi: sự phong phú về văn hóa

examples.en: Preserving cultural richness should be a central goal of any tourism development plan.

title: local tradition
meaning_vi: truyền thống địa phương

examples.en: Local traditions are sometimes commercialised to satisfy tourist expectations rather than preserved authentically.

title: interracial understanding
meaning_vi: sự hiểu biết giữa các chủng tộc

examples.en: Travel abroad often fosters interracial understanding that textbooks alone cannot provide.

title: taking a closer look into the locals' mindset
term: taking a closer look into the locals' mindset
pronunciation: /ˈteɪkɪŋ ə ˈkləʊsə lʊk ˈɪntə ðə ˈləʊklz ˈmaɪndset/
meaning_vi: tìm hiểu sâu hơn về tư duy của người dân bản địa

examples.en: Taking a closer look into the locals' mindset allows tourists to appreciate customs they once found strange.

title: to believe in false preconceptions
meaning_vi: tin vào những định kiến sai lầm

examples.en: Without direct contact through travel, people are more likely to believe in false preconceptions about other cultures.

title: share the same root
meaning_vi: có cùng nguồn gốc

examples.en: Despite their different languages, the two ethnic groups share the same root, a fact that tourism brochures rarely mention.

title: customs and superstitions
meaning_vi: phong tục và các điều mê tín

examples.en: Guidebooks should explain local customs and superstitions so that tourists do not act inappropriately at religious sites.

title: unscrupulous schemes
meaning_vi: những kế hoạch phi đạo đức

examples.en: Some agencies run unscrupulous schemes that stage fake ceremonies purely to entertain paying tourists.

title: fulfill their desire for exoticism
meaning_vi: thỏa mãn mong muốn về sự kỳ lạ, mới lạ

examples.en: Many travellers visit remote villages simply to fulfill their desire for exoticism.

title: appeal to tourists
meaning_vi: thu hút du khách

examples.en: Local craftsmen have started simplifying their designs to appeal to tourists in a hurry.

title: an attempt to appeal to tourists
term: an attempt to appeal to tourists
meaning_vi: một nỗ lực nhằm thu hút du khách

examples.en: The festival was rescheduled to the summer in an attempt to appeal to tourists visiting during school holidays.

title: internationalism
meaning_vi: chủ nghĩa quốc tế, xu hướng toàn cầu hóa

examples.en: Growing internationalism has encouraged more people to settle and work in countries far from their homeland.

title: to a moderate extent
meaning_vi: ở một mức độ vừa phải

examples.en: To a moderate extent, learning the local language helps expatriates integrate more smoothly into a new culture.

title: notoriously difficult to learn
meaning_vi: nổi tiếng là khó học

examples.en: Tonal languages such as Mandarin are notoriously difficult to learn for most Western expatriates.

title: fluent in more than one language
term: fluent in more than one language
meaning_vi: thông thạo nhiều hơn một ngôn ngữ

examples.en: Being fluent in more than one language gives tour guides a significant advantage when dealing with international visitors.

title: poor outreach
meaning_vi: công tác tiếp cận cộng đồng kém

examples.en: Poor outreach is one of the main reasons heritage sites fail to connect with younger residents.

title: current issues
meaning_vi: các vấn đề thời sự

examples.en: Exhibitions that address current issues tend to resonate more strongly with local communities.

title: authentic experience
meaning_vi: trải nghiệm chân thực

examples.en: Travellers seeking an authentic experience often avoid resorts in favour of homestays with local families.

title: cultural heritage
meaning_vi: di sản văn hóa

examples.en: UNESCO recognition can help protect a site's cultural heritage from being commercially exploited.

title: standardized urban planning
meaning_vi: quy hoạch đô thị theo khuôn mẫu chung

examples.en: Standardized urban planning has stripped many tourist cities of their unique character.

title: cultural erosion
meaning_vi: sự xói mòn văn hóa

examples.en: Critics argue that mass tourism accelerates cultural erosion in historically rich neighbourhoods.

title: facilitated cross-cultural understanding
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy sự hiểu biết giữa các nền văn hóa

examples.en: For decades, tourism has facilitated cross-cultural understanding between people from vastly different backgrounds.

title: unintentionally offend the local values
meaning_vi: vô tình xúc phạm các giá trị của người bản địa

examples.en: Without prior research, a foreign visitor may unintentionally offend the local values simply by dressing inappropriately.

title: erodes the local culture
meaning_vi: làm xói mòn văn hóa địa phương

examples.en: Critics argue that unregulated tourism gradually erodes the local culture by prioritising foreign tastes.

title: monetize ancient traditions
meaning_vi: thương mại hóa các truyền thống cổ xưa

examples.en: Some operators monetize ancient traditions by turning sacred ceremonies into paid photo opportunities.

title: capitalizing on local cultural customs
meaning_vi: lợi dụng các phong tục văn hóa địa phương

examples.en: Capitalizing on local cultural customs to sell souvenirs can gradually strip a ritual of its original meaning.

title: leading to the loss of authenticity
term: leading to the loss of authenticity
meaning_vi: dẫn đến sự mất đi tính chân thực

examples.en: Constant catering to foreign tastes is leading to the loss of authenticity in many traditional markets.

title: appeal to tourists for their ideas
term: appeal to tourists for their ideas
meaning_vi: chiều theo quan niệm/ý tưởng của du khách

examples.en: Local dance troupes now appeal to tourists for their ideas of what an authentic performance should look like.

title: semblance of the old tradition
meaning_vi: vẻ ngoài giống với truyền thống cũ

examples.en: Only a semblance of the old tradition remains after decades of adapting the ceremony for tour buses.

title: nearly extinct
meaning_vi: gần như tuyệt chủng, biến mất

examples.en: Several local dialects are nearly extinct, having been replaced by English to accommodate tourists.

title: corruption of local cultures
meaning_vi: sự tha hóa/biến chất của văn hóa địa phương

examples.en: Some scholars blame the corruption of local cultures on the relentless pursuit of tourist dollars.

title: forces unwanted constraints on the locals
term: forces unwanted constraints on the locals
meaning_vi: áp đặt những ràng buộc không mong muốn lên người dân địa phương

examples.en: Catering endlessly to visitor expectations sometimes forces unwanted constraints on the locals, who must alter their daily routines.

title: becomes performative and begins to lose its significance
term: becomes performative and begins to lose its significance
pronunciation: /bɪˈkʌmz pəˈfɔːmətɪv ænd bɪˈɡɪnz tə luːz ɪts sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəns/
meaning_vi: trở nên mang tính trình diễn và bắt đầu mất đi ý nghĩa vốn có

examples.en: When staged nightly for tourists, a sacred ritual becomes performative and begins to lose its significance for local worshippers.

title: modify traditional customs
meaning_vi: thay đổi các phong tục truyền thống

examples.en: Some communities modify traditional customs to make festivals more entertaining for foreign visitors.

title: overcommercialization
meaning_vi: sự thương mại hóa quá mức

examples.en: Critics argue that the overcommercialization of the old town has stripped it of its authentic charm.

title: cultural institutions
meaning_vi: các tổ chức văn hóa

examples.en: Cultural institutions such as museums and galleries often struggle to attract visitors from their own city.

title: sense of familiarity
meaning_vi: cảm giác quen thuộc

examples.en: A sense of familiarity with local landmarks often stops residents from ever visiting them as tourists would.

title: heritage sites
meaning_vi: các di tích/di sản

examples.en: Heritage sites play a crucial role in preserving a nation's cultural identity for future generations.

title: enchant the tourists
meaning_vi: làm mê hoặc du khách

examples.en: Colourful festivals are often staged year-round simply to enchant the tourists rather than to honour tradition.

title: promote peace
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy hòa bình

examples.en: Some scholars argue that international tourism can promote peace by reducing prejudice between nations.

title: correct existing prejudices
meaning_vi: sửa chữa những định kiến sẵn có

examples.en: Cultural exchange programmes can help correct existing prejudices that visitors hold about a host nation.

title: proactive
meaning_vi: chủ động

examples.en: Responsible travellers should be proactive in reading about the customs of the country they intend to visit.

title: preserve the culture
meaning_vi: bảo tồn văn hóa

examples.en: Strict regulations on new construction help preserve the culture of the old town centre.

title: promotional efforts
meaning_vi: nỗ lực quảng bá

examples.en: Promotional efforts for heritage attractions are usually aimed at foreign visitors rather than local residents.

title: dynamic and inclusive strategies
meaning_vi: chiến lược năng động và hòa nhập

examples.en: Adopting dynamic and inclusive strategies can help museums attract a broader range of visitors.

title: regularly updating exhibitions
meaning_vi: thường xuyên cập nhật các triển lãm

examples.en: Regularly updating exhibitions gives repeat visitors a reason to return to the same museum.

title: hosting interactive events
meaning_vi: tổ chức các sự kiện tương tác

examples.en: Hosting interactive events at heritage sites encourages families to engage with local history in a hands-on way.

title: reframe the museum experience
meaning_vi: tái định hình trải nghiệm bảo tàng

examples.en: By using digital displays, curators can reframe the museum experience to appeal to younger audiences.

title: have little respect for
meaning_vi: ít tôn trọng

examples.en: A minority of visitors have little respect for the fragile ecosystems they walk through.

title: radiation exposure
meaning_vi: sự phơi nhiễm bức xạ

examples.en: Prolonged radiation exposure remains one of the greatest concerns for passengers on space tourism flights.

title: extreme temperatures
meaning_vi: nhiệt độ khắc nghiệt

examples.en: Travellers venturing into remote regions must be prepared to cope with extreme temperatures.

title: necessitates the construction of more infrastructure
term: necessitates the construction of more infrastructure
meaning_vi: đòi hỏi phải xây dựng thêm cơ sở hạ tầng

examples.en: The rapid growth of tourism necessitates the construction of more infrastructure, including roads and airports.

title: destruction of natural habitats
meaning_vi: sự phá hủy môi trường sống tự nhiên

examples.en: Unregulated resort construction has led to the destruction of natural habitats along many coastlines.

title: further exacerbates the harm to fragile ecosystems
term: further exacerbates the harm to fragile ecosystems
pronunciation: /ˈfɜːðər ɪɡˈzæsəbeɪts ðə hɑːm tə ˈfrædʒaɪl ˈiːkəʊsɪstəmz/
meaning_vi: làm trầm trọng thêm thiệt hại đối với các hệ sinh thái mong manh

examples.en: Excessive foot traffic further exacerbates the harm to fragile ecosystems found in coral reefs and rainforests.

title: ecological and social challenges
meaning_vi: những thách thức về sinh thái và xã hội

examples.en: Despite the ecological and social challenges it creates, tourism remains a vital source of national income.

title: litter all over the beaches
meaning_vi: vứt rác bừa bãi khắp bãi biển

examples.en: During peak season, holidaymakers litter all over the beaches, leaving volunteers to clean up afterwards.

title: have deleterious effects on the environment
term: have deleterious effects on the environment
meaning_vi: gây ra những ảnh hưởng có hại đến môi trường

examples.en: Unregulated trekking routes can have deleterious effects on the environment by eroding fragile mountain soil.

title: act as a detriment to the local environment
term: act as a detriment to the local environment
pronunciation: /ækt æz ə ˈdetrɪmənt tə ðə ˈləʊkəl ɪnˈvaɪərənmənt/
meaning_vi: gây tổn hại cho môi trường địa phương

examples.en: Poorly managed cruise ports can act as a detriment to the local environment through waste and pollution.

title: drastically change the landscape
meaning_vi: thay đổi mạnh mẽ cảnh quan

examples.en: Large-scale hotel construction can drastically change the landscape of once-quiet coastal towns.

title: the loss of habitat for local species
term: the loss of habitat for local species
pronunciation: /ðə lɒs əv ˈhæbɪtæt fɔː ˈləʊkəl ˈspiːʃiːz/
meaning_vi: sự mất môi trường sống của các loài bản địa

examples.en: Deforestation for new resorts has led to the loss of habitat for local species along the riverbank.

title: pose certain hazards
meaning_vi: gây ra những nguy hiểm nhất định

examples.en: Space tourism can pose certain hazards that far exceed the risks of conventional air travel.

title: collisions with space debris
meaning_vi: va chạm với các mảnh vỡ không gian

examples.en: Engineers must design spacecraft carefully to reduce the risk of collisions with space debris.

title: prevent the overexploitation of natural resources
term: prevent the overexploitation of natural resources
meaning_vi: ngăn chặn việc khai thác quá mức tài nguyên thiên nhiên

examples.en: Strict quotas can prevent the overexploitation of natural resources in popular national parks.

title: implementation of sustainable tourism practices
meaning_vi: việc áp dụng các phương thức du lịch bền vững

examples.en: The implementation of sustainable tourism practices can help destinations grow without degrading the environment.

title: promoting eco-friendly accommodations
meaning_vi: khuyến khích chỗ nghỉ thân thiện với môi trường

examples.en: Promoting eco-friendly accommodations encourages tourists to reduce their environmental footprint while travelling.

title: geared toward tourists
meaning_vi: hướng tới đối tượng khách du lịch

examples.en: Many city centre attractions are geared toward tourists, leaving little incentive for locals to explore them.

title: digital media
meaning_vi: phương tiện truyền thông kỹ thuật số

examples.en: Digital media has fuelled the popularity of certain destinations, sometimes leading to overcrowding.

title: sentiment
meaning_vi: quan điểm, tình cảm chung

examples.en: Public sentiment towards mass tourism has shifted as residents grow tired of overcrowded streets.

title: mass tourism
meaning_vi: du lịch đại chúng

examples.en: Mass tourism has transformed once-quiet fishing villages into crowded resort towns.

title: the influx of
meaning_vi: dòng người/lượng đổ vào

examples.en: The influx of cruise passengers each summer puts enormous strain on the island's water supply.

title: the proliferation of global travel
meaning_vi: sự gia tăng nhanh chóng của du lịch toàn cầu

examples.en: The proliferation of global travel over the past two decades has placed unprecedented pressure on natural landmarks.

title: mass travel
meaning_vi: du lịch đại chúng

examples.en: Mass travel has made once-remote temples accessible, but at the cost of their tranquillity.

title: mark a new tendency of the tourist industry
term: mark a new tendency of the tourist industry
pronunciation: /mɑːk ə njuː ˈtendənsi əv ðə ˈtʊərɪst ˈɪndəstri/
meaning_vi: đánh dấu một xu hướng mới của ngành du lịch

examples.en: The rise of eco-lodges seems to mark a new tendency of the tourist industry towards sustainability.

title: hordes of tourists
meaning_vi: đám đông khách du lịch

examples.en: Every summer, hordes of tourists descend on the small island, overwhelming its narrow streets.

title: dispute
meaning_vi: tranh chấp, bất đồng

examples.en: Overcrowded tourist sites have occasionally led to disputes between visitors and local residents.

title: disillusionment of many tourists
meaning_vi: sự vỡ mộng của nhiều du khách

examples.en: The disillusionment of many tourists stems from finding a destination far less authentic than advertised.

title: artificial
meaning_vi: giả tạo, nhân tạo

examples.en: What was once a genuine tribal ritual has become an artificial performance staged twice daily for coach tours.

title: is always packed with
meaning_vi: luôn chật kín, đông nghẹt

examples.en: The old quarter is always packed with tour groups, making it hard for residents to go about their day.

title: a generic, commercialized shell
meaning_vi: một cái vỏ chung chung, đã bị thương mại hóa

examples.en: Over-development can turn a historic town into a generic, commercialized shell of its former self.

title: lose their charm
meaning_vi: mất đi sự quyến rũ, nét duyên

examples.en: Many coastal villages lose their charm once high-rise hotels dominate the skyline.

title: travel to more secluded places
meaning_vi: đi du lịch đến những nơi hẻo lánh hơn

examples.en: Adventurous backpackers often travel to more secluded places that mainstream tour operators overlook.

title: protest
meaning_vi: phản đối

examples.en: Residents in Venice regularly protest against the sheer number of cruise ships docking each day.

title: foreign locales
meaning_vi: địa điểm ở nước ngoài

examples.en: Social media influencers have made once-obscure foreign locales into overcrowded tourist hotspots.

title: inexpensive methods of travelling internationally
meaning_vi: các phương thức du lịch quốc tế với chi phí thấp

examples.en: Inexpensive methods of travelling internationally, such as budget airlines, have opened up tourism to the middle class.

title: hospitality sector
meaning_vi: ngành dịch vụ lưu trú, khách sạn

examples.en: The hospitality sector was among the hardest hit when international borders closed during the pandemic.

title: aviation industry
meaning_vi: ngành hàng không

examples.en: Growth in the aviation industry has drastically cut the cost of visiting far-flung destinations.

title: time constraints
meaning_vi: hạn chế về thời gian

examples.en: Because of time constraints, many business travellers only manage to see a handful of landmarks during their trip.

title: package tours to distant destinations
meaning_vi: các tour trọn gói đến những điểm đến xa xôi

examples.en: Package tours to distant destinations have made once-remote mountain villages popular with mainstream travellers.

title: urban planners
meaning_vi: nhà quy hoạch đô thị

examples.en: Urban planners must balance the needs of residents against the demands of the tourism industry.

title: illegal trafficking
meaning_vi: buôn bán/vận chuyển trái phép

examples.en: Authorities have tightened border checks to curb the illegal trafficking of wildlife driven by tourist demand for souvenirs.

title: have little trouble renting houses
meaning_vi: không gặp mấy khó khăn khi thuê nhà

examples.en: Foreigners who speak the local language have little trouble renting houses in residential neighbourhoods.

title: offers orbital flights
meaning_vi: cung cấp các chuyến bay quỹ đạo

examples.en: Several private companies now offer orbital flights to wealthy adventure tourists.

title: effective government policies and regulations
meaning_vi: các chính sách và quy định hiệu quả của chính phủ

examples.en: Effective government policies and regulations are essential to limit the environmental damage caused by tourism.

title: foster
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy, nuôi dưỡng

examples.en: Government subsidies were introduced to foster the growth of small, locally owned guesthouses.

title: carried out
meaning_vi: (verb phrase (past participle)). được thực hiện, tiến hành

examples.en: Environmental impact assessments should be carried out before any new resort is approved.

title: have the incentives to
meaning_vi: có động lực để

examples.en: Tax breaks mean that hoteliers have the incentives to invest in renewable energy.

title: open their borders to international tourists
term: open their borders to international tourists
meaning_vi: mở cửa biên giới cho du khách quốc tế

examples.en: Several island nations decided to open their borders to international tourists in order to revive their struggling economies.

title: local engagement
meaning_vi: sự tham gia của người dân địa phương

examples.en: Without strong local engagement, tourism development can easily become disconnected from community needs.

title: minority people
meaning_vi: người dân tộc thiểu số

examples.en: Tourism revenue is rarely shared fairly with the minority people whose villages attract the visitors.

title: fresh graduate
meaning_vi: sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp

examples.en: As a fresh graduate, she took a job with a tour company to gain hands-on experience in the industry.

title: generate local interest
meaning_vi: tạo sự quan tâm của người dân địa phương

examples.en: Free entry days can generate local interest in attractions that residents would otherwise overlook.

title: to make their living
meaning_vi: kiếm sống

examples.en: In coastal towns, thousands of families rely on fishing tours to make their living.

title: displaced natives living on reservations
meaning_vi: người bản địa bị di dời sống trong khu bảo tồn

examples.en: Tour operators rarely mention that some attractions were built on land once occupied by displaced natives living on reservations.

title: work for local companies
meaning_vi: làm việc cho các công ty địa phương

examples.en: Expatriates who work for local companies are usually expected to have at least basic proficiency in the native language.

title: a language requirement
meaning_vi: yêu cầu về ngôn ngữ

examples.en: Many hospitality jobs in remote resorts come with a language requirement to ensure smooth communication with local staff.

title: create a sense of belonging
meaning_vi: tạo cảm giác thuộc về, hòa nhập

examples.en: Learning the local dialect can create a sense of belonging for long-term residents in a foreign town.

title: create personal connections
meaning_vi: tạo dựng các mối quan hệ cá nhân

examples.en: Speaking with villagers in their own language helps tourists create personal connections that a guidebook never could.

title: beneficial to the local residents
meaning_vi: có lợi cho cư dân địa phương

examples.en: Well-planned tourism development can be highly beneficial to the local residents by creating new sources of income.
